name: eng114-regional-1024m-soak-reset-2min-deferred
description: Sustained-load run of the full 4096-cell seed-1 authoritative world with eight regional deferred-catalogue clients, all links unshaped, clients 0 and 1 repeating the outbound/return movement path. From tick 3000 for 7200 ticks, 1200 ordinary radius-2 terrain cuts (10 per second) and 12 radius-8 (4 m diameter) blasts (one per 10 s) at positions drawn from a fixed LCG (seed 0xE114) over x,z in [600,3500) at y=16, spread round-robin over all clients; one world reset at tick 6000 (mid edit stream). Every scripted cut must commit and every client must finish with the server's exact final hash. Not the G4 population (256 active / 4,096 sleeping bodies), whole-foundation collapse or GPU acceptance. Links are unshaped: a shaped regional client resolves only about 0.3 distant edits per second (each costs a ~33 KB dense-brick repair over a ~22 KB/s link), so this edit rate with impaired clients is outside what the protocol carries today; impaired links are covered by the lighter fixtures.
